reason: The array is covered in grit, so brushing it seems like a practical first step toward restoring solar power.
expectation: I expect to clear the panels and make the array ready to supply power again, though restarting services may take more steps.

alternatives.reason: Refilling the water line also seems relevant, but restoring power first seems useful for the restart.

effect: Brushing the array restored the solar supply, making the plant restart controls available.
reaction: That was a straightforward, satisfying first step.
reason: The water line was drained for the storm, so restoring it seems useful before restarting the plant.
expectation: I expect the line to be prepared for water service, though it may need checks before it can be refilled.

alternatives.reason: Restarting the plant is the other obvious next step, but I want to address the drained line first.

effect: The exterior line is primed and water is reaching the cabin tap again, so the water service is restored.
reaction: The explanation of pushing air out made the restart feel concrete.
reason: The restored solar supply can now be used at the plant restart controls, which directly supports restarting essential services.
expectation: I expect the plant to restart using solar power, though other services may still need attention.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce back to the window seems useful, but I want to restart the plant first.

effect: The return plant is running again, though it will need weeks to replace propellant lost during shutdown. The next goal is to move both troughs back to the window.
reaction: The boil-off was a useful reminder that stored propellant can be lost during a shutdown.
reason: Both troughs need to return to the window, and the lettuce is ready to place there.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to move onto the window shelf, leaving the potato trough to move afterward.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go to the window; either placement seems like a reasonable first choice.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only available gameplay action and completes the remaining placement.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to join the lettuce at the window and the goal to be completed.

effect: The potato trough joined the lettuce at the window, completing the chapter’s remaining goal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the return plant was most worthwhile: its checks and the loss of stored propellant made the storm’s consequences concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was repetitive, though it made sense after sheltering them during the storm.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: Neither trough placement felt arbitrary, but their order did not seem meaningful.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the return journey and the preserved specimen unfold; restarting the plant made that prospect feel closer, despite the delay.
